scope.current_boundary: Teach the principle of conservation of momentum in an isolated system, its mathematical derivation from Newton's second and third laws, 1D collision and explosion problem-solving with vector sign conventions, coalescing bodies, and qualitative 2D collision vector triangles. Do not pre-teach elastic versus inelastic collision definitions, relative speed of approach equals separation, or kinetic energy conservation checks, which are strictly reserved for lesson 7.

Assumes vector addition and component resolution from 9702_t01_cm05_l11.
